description: This file manages a compilation cache system for the Playwright project, including in-memory and disk caching, source map support, dependency tracking, and cache serialization/deserialization. It handles cache directory setup, cache retrieval, cache updating, and dependency analysis for files involved in the compilation process.

classes.name: MemoryCache
classes.description: Type defining the structure of cached memory data, including paths to code, source map, and data files, with an optional module URL.

classes.name: SerializedCompilationCache
classes.description: Type defining the structure of the serialized cache containing source maps, memory cache entries, file dependencies, and external dependencies.

methods.name: installSourceMapSupport
methods.description: Sets up source map support for better stack traces in Node.js, with retrieval of source maps from the cache.

methods.name: getFromCompilationCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached code and source maps from memory or disk cache based on filename and hash.

methods.name: serializeCompilationCache
methods.description: Serializes the current in-memory cache state into a structured object for persistence or transfer.

methods.name: addToCompilationCache
methods.description: Adds cache data from a serialized cache payload into the current cache state.

methods.name: startCollectingFileDeps
methods.description: Begins dependency collection for a file.

methods.name: stopCollectingFileDeps
methods.description: Stops dependency collection for a file and updates dependency maps.

methods.name: currentFileDepsCollector
methods.description: Returns the current set used for dependency collection.

methods.name: setExternalDependencies
methods.description: Sets external dependencies for a given file.

methods.name: fileDependenciesForTest
methods.description: Returns the current file dependencies map.

methods.name: collectAffectedTestFiles
methods.description: Identifies test files affected by a changed file based on dependency graphs.

methods.name: affectedTestFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of test files affected by a list of changed files.

methods.name: internalDependenciesForTestFile
methods.description: Returns internal dependencies for a specific test file.

methods.name: dependenciesForTestFile
methods.description: Returns all dependencies, including external, for a specific test file.

methods.name: belongsToNodeModules
methods.description: Checks if a file is part of node_modules or internal playwright files.

methods.name: getUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a plugin from cached data files.
